draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.18, the 100th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 6th of 20 at S. He lasted until pick 134, well after his grade rank (100th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing standouts: broad jump (90th percentile). College production: 56 tackles in 2022, 19th of 20 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Minnesota Vikings. 50 career games and 5 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (4 AV) was his best yet. Weak spots: passes defended 0 (8th percentile), interceptions 0 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 safety who played: 23.2% season snap share against a median of 51.8%, below the norm.
